verdict.rationale: Pilot only mentions consolidated reporting narrowly for 'US entities with foreign subsidiaries' via a one-line FAQ note, with no detail on multi-entity management, intercompany eliminations, or general multi-entity consolidation workflows. missing for 10: documentation on multi-entity setup/management, consolidation methodology, intercompany eliminations, support for multiple US entities (not just foreign subsidiaries), independent evidence of consolidated financials being produced.
